func: const body = msg.payload || {}; const db = global.get('db'); const lookup = await db.ref('credential_lookup/pin/' + String(body.value).replace(/[.#$\[\]\/]/g, '_')).once('value'); const cred = (await db.ref('credentials/' + lookup.val()).once('value')).val(); const user = cred ? (await db.ref('users/' + cred.user_id).once('value')).val() : null; if (!cred || !user) return { payload: { cmd: 'DENY' } }; const now = new Date().toISOString(); await db.ref('access_logs').push({ user_id: user.id || cred.user_id, username: user.username, method: body.authMethod, time: now }); const status = (await db.ref('door_status').once('value')).val() || {}; await db.ref('door_status').set({ state: 'unlocked', method: body.authMethod, user: user.username, lockdown: status.lockdown || false, updatedAt: now }); return { payload: { cmd: 'GRANT' } };

name: Danh sách 2FA theo user
func: if (msg.authError) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: msg.authError }; return msg; } if (msg.authUser.role !== 'admin') { msg.statusCode = 403; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: 'Chỉ admin được phép' }; return msg; } const db = global.get('db'); const userId = msg.req.params.id; const snap = await db.ref('twofa_accounts').orderByChild('user_id').equalTo(userId).once('value'); const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567'; const totp = (secret) => { let bits = ''; for (const c of secret) bits += alphabet.indexOf(c).toString(2).padStart(5, '0'); const key = []; for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) key.push(parseInt(bits.slice(i, i + 8), 2)); const counter = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000 / 30); const buffer = Buffer.alloc(8); buffer.writeUInt32BE(Math.floor(counter / 4294967296), 0); buffer.writeUInt32BE(counter >>> 0, 4); const digest = global.get('crypto').createHmac('sha1', Buffer.from(key)).update(buffer).digest(); const offset = digest[digest.length - 1] & 15; const code = ((digest[offset] & 127) << 24 | (digest[offset + 1] & 255) << 16 | (digest[offset + 2] & 255) << 8 | (digest[offset + 3] & 255)) % 1000000; return String(code).padStart(6, '0'); }; const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000); const rows = []; snap.forEach((child) => { const item = child.val(); const remaining = 30 - (now % 30); rows.push({ id: child.key, label: item.label, otp: totp(item.secret), remaining, expiresAt: (now + remaining) * 1000, otpauth: 'otpauth://totp/HGM:' + encodeURIComponent(item.label) + '?secret=' + item.secret + '&issuer=HGM&algorithm=SHA1&digits=6&period=30' }); }); msg.payload = rows; return msg;

name: Tạo 2FA cho user
func: if (msg.authError) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: msg.authError }; return msg; } if (msg.authUser.role !== 'admin') { msg.statusCode = 403; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: 'Chỉ admin được phép' }; return msg; } const userId = msg.req.params.id; const label = String((msg.payload || {}).label || '').trim(); if (!label) { msg.statusCode = 400; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: 'Tên tài khoản không được để trống' }; return msg; } const db = global.get('db'); const userSnap = await db.ref('users/' + userId).once('value'); if (!userSnap.exists()) { msg.statusCode = 404; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: 'Không tìm thấy user' }; return msg; } const bytes = global.get('crypto').randomBytes(20); const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567'; let bits = ''; for (const byte of bytes) bits += byte.toString(2).padStart(8, '0'); let secret = ''; for (let i = 0; i < bits.length; i += 5) secret += alphabet[parseInt(bits.slice(i, i + 5).padEnd(5, '0'), 2)]; const ref = db.ref('twofa_accounts').push(); await ref.set({ user_id: userId, label, secret, created_at: new Date().toISOString(), created_by: msg.authUser.id }); msg.payload = { ok: true, id: ref.key, label, message: 'Đã tạo secret 2FA cho user' }; return msg;

name: Xóa tài khoản 2FA
func: if (msg.authError) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: msg.authError }; return msg; } if (msg.authUser.role !== 'admin') { msg.statusCode = 403; msg.payload = { ok: false, error: 'Chỉ admin được phép' }; return msg; } const db = global.get('db'); await db.ref('twofa_accounts/' + msg.req.params.id).remove(); msg.payload = { ok: true, message: 'Đã xóa tài khoản 2FA' }; return msg;
